newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsuzuka says G7 accord filtered into market - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Mitsuzuka says G7 accord filtered into market - Jiji.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka was quoted by Jiji news agency on Thursday as saying that the agreement on currencies by the Group of Seven (G7) industrialised nations has "sufficiently" filtered into the currency market.
Mitsuzuka was commenting on the fall of the dollar below 116 yen in Tokyo's morning trade, Jiji said.
"Looking at currency moves since last week, I can say the G7 agreement has sufficiently filtered through the currency market," Mitsuzuka was quoted as saying.
He repeated the same answer when asked separately if the yen's rise was excessive, Jiji added.
